cases.title: Aggregate approved earnings once per employee
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: standard.
cases.data: Amara: NGN120,000 + NGN30,000; Daniel: NGN200,000; Zara: NGN85,000. All approved.
steps: Create a standard workspace.
Process the 13 October pay run.
Read the payment ledger and notification states.
cases.expected: Exactly three payments total NGN435,000. Amara receives one NGN150,000 payment. Every payment notification is sent.

cases.title: Include an earning exactly at the opening boundary
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: empty.
steps: Import the approved earning at opening Monday midnight.
Process the 13 October run.
Read recorded pay.
cases.expected: The opening-boundary earning is included; recorded pay is NGN150,000.

cases.title: Defer the excluded closing-boundary earning to the next period
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: boundaries.
cases.data: Opening boundary: NGN10,000; before opening: NGN20,000; just before closing: NGN30,000; exactly 2026-10-12T00:00:00Z: NGN40,000.
steps: Create the boundaries workspace.
Process the 13 October run and inspect selected earning IDs.
Process the 20 October run.
Compare the period totals and payment count.
cases.expected: The first run pays NGN40,000 from start + last only. The NGN40,000 closing-boundary earning is paid in the next period; two payment records exist across both periods.

cases.title: Normalize Lagos timestamps before selecting earnings
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: empty.
steps: Import both offset-aware earnings.
Process the 13 October run.
Inspect earning IDs included in the employee payment.
cases.expected: Only inside qualifies. outside normalizes to the preceding Sunday; inside normalizes to opening Monday midnight. Total recorded pay is NGN150,000.

cases.title: Do not increase payroll when an identical earning is reimported
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: single.
cases.data: Existing earn-001, emp-001, approved, 2026-10-08T12:00:00Z, 15000000 kobo. Import two identical copies.
steps: Reimport the same earning twice using its original ID and values.
Process the pay run.
Count earnings and inspect recorded pay.
cases.expected: One earning record remains; one payment records NGN150,000.

cases.title: Roll back a whole import containing a conflicting duplicate
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: single.
cases.data: Batch: new earning ID new, then existing earn-001 with amount changed to 1 kobo.
steps: Submit both records in one import request.
Inspect the HTTP status.
Reload the earning list.
cases.expected: HTTP 409. The new record is rolled back and the original earning remains unchanged; the list still has one earning.

cases.title: Block payroll while an earning awaits approval
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: empty.
cases.data: One pending earn-001 for NGN150,000.
steps: Import the pending earning.
Attempt to process the period.
Inspect the ledger, notifications and period lock.
cases.expected: HTTP 409. The period remains open; no payment or notification exists.

cases.title: Create no notification when payment fails, then recover safely
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: single.
cases.data: One approved NGN150,000 earning; one-shot payout failure before ledger write.
steps: Arm the payout fault through the local fixture API.
Process the pay run.
Inspect payments, notifications and provider acceptance.
Retry the original run and inspect the ledger.
cases.expected: First attempt: zero payment, zero notification and zero provider acceptance. Retry: one NGN150,000 payment.

cases.title: Retain a successful payment when notification delivery fails
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: single.
cases.data: One approved NGN150,000 earning; one-shot notification failure before provider acceptance.
steps: Arm the notification fault through the local fixture API.
Process the pay run once.
Inspect the ledger, pending notification and event order.
cases.expected: The NGN150,000 payment remains recorded. One notification is pending, no provider acceptance exists, and payment_committed occurs before notification_attempted.

cases.title: Preserve one payment when retrying after notification failure
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: single.
cases.data: One approved NGN150,000 earning; one-shot notification failure. UI path: Pay runs.
steps: Arm the notification fault and open the printed workspace pay-run URL.
Select Review and process payroll, then confirm Process payroll.
Record the first payment reference and pending message ID.
Select Retry pay run and confirm.
Compare pay amount, payment count, original payment object and message identity.
cases.expected: Exactly one NGN150,000 payment remains, with the complete original payment object unchanged. The original notification ID is retained and its pending work is recovered.

cases.title: Preserve payment identity when recovery runs in a fresh process
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: single.
cases.data: One approved NGN150,000 earning; persistent temporary SQLite file; notification failure.
steps: Process with notification failure and record the payment reference.
Close the service database.
Spawn a fresh Node process against that same file and workspace.
Retry the original pay run and inspect the result.
cases.expected: The fresh process retains exactly one NGN150,000 payment with the original ID and recovers the pending notification.

cases.title: Recover delivery without changing any payment object
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: single.
cases.data: Successful NGN150,000 payment with one pending notification.
steps: Cause notification failure after a successful payment.
Invoke retry-notifications without rerunning payroll.
Compare complete payment objects and provider acceptance.
cases.expected: Payment objects remain unchanged, pending notification count becomes zero, and provider acceptance is exactly one.

cases.title: Commit payment and notification work atomically
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: single.
cases.data: One approved NGN150,000 earning; one-shot interruption after payment insert and before notification-work insert.
steps: Arm the persistence fault.
Process once and inspect both tables and rollback event.
Retry the original run after the fault is consumed.
Inspect the recovered payment count and amount.
cases.expected: Interrupted transaction leaves zero payments and zero notifications and records payment_rolled_back. Retry creates exactly one NGN150,000 payment.

cases.title: Recover an ambiguous delivery result without another payment
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: single.
cases.data: One approved NGN150,000 earning; provider accepts once but one acknowledgment is lost.
steps: Arm the ambiguous acknowledgment fault.
Process once; inspect provider acceptance and pending delivery.
Retry the original pay run.
Inspect acceptance count, pending work and payment count.
cases.expected: First attempt has one provider acceptance and one pending notification. Retry leaves one provider acceptance, one payment and zero pending notifications.

cases.title: Reject new earnings in a period already processed
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: single.
cases.data: Approved NGN150,000 paid once; attempt to import a new earning ID late in that same period.
steps: Process the original period.
Attempt to import the new in-period earning.
Retry the original pay run and compare totals.
cases.expected: Import returns HTTP 409. Approved and recorded payroll remain NGN150,000.

cases.title: Record one payment across eight requests to one server
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: single.
cases.data: One approved NGN150,000 earning; first notification attempt fails; eight overlapping HTTP run requests.
steps: Arm the notification fault.
Send eight run requests concurrently to the same Node server.
Wait for all responses and inspect workspace state.
cases.expected: One NGN150,000 payment remains and the notification is recovered. This verifies one server, not distributed-worker execution.

cases.title: Allow a distinct payment for the same employee in the next period
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: single.
cases.data: First period NGN150,000; next earning ID next, earned 2026-10-12T00:00:00Z, NGN50,000.
steps: Process the 13 October run.
Import the next-period earning.
Process the 20 October run.
Inspect selected-period total and cross-period records.
cases.expected: Next-period recorded pay is NGN50,000. Two pay runs and two employee-period payment records exist.

cases.title: Reject ambiguous dates and invalid pay schedules
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: empty.
steps: Submit an earning with each invalid timestamp.
Attempt the Wednesday pay run.
Inspect each HTTP response.
cases.expected: Every invalid request returns HTTP 400.

cases.title: Require positive bounded whole-kobo amounts
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: empty.
cases.data: Invalid amountMinor values: 0, -1, 1.5, 100000001, string 15000000. Valid minimum: 1 kobo.
steps: Attempt to import each invalid amount.
Import a one-kobo approved earning.
Process payroll and inspect its amount.
cases.expected: Invalid imports return HTTP 400. One kobo is accepted and pays NGN0.01.

cases.title: Reject unknown employees and empty approved payroll
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: empty.
cases.data: Unknown employeeId unknown; no approved earnings.
steps: Attempt an earning for the unknown employee.
Attempt to process the empty approved period.
Inspect response statuses.
cases.expected: Unknown-employee import returns HTTP 400; empty approved payroll returns HTTP 409.

cases.title: Keep identical fixture IDs isolated between workspaces
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: single in two workspaces.
cases.data: Same employee and earning IDs in workspaces A and B.
steps: Create A and B independently.
Process A.
Confirm B has no payments.
Process B.
cases.expected: A does not alter B. B can independently record its own NGN150,000 payment.

cases.title: Make approval replay harmless and reject rejected earnings
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: empty.
cases.data: Pending earn-001: NGN150,000; rejected earning rejected: NGN50,000.
steps: Import both records.
Approve earn-001 twice.
Attempt approval of the rejected earning.
Process payroll and inspect contributing IDs.
cases.expected: Approval replay is harmless; rejected approval returns HTTP 409. Only earn-001 contributes; total is NGN150,000.

cases.title: Record, approve and pay a precise amount through the UI
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: empty.
cases.data: Amara; description Approved project delivery; amount NGN150,000.25; pending approval.
steps: Open Earnings and enter the description and amount.
Record the earning, then approve it.
Open Pay runs, review the amount and confirm processing.
Inspect recorded payroll.
cases.expected: The confirmation and resulting ledger both use NGN150,000.25.

cases.title: Leave payroll unchanged when confirmation is cancelled
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: single.
cases.data: Pay-run confirmation opened; Escape pressed.
steps: Open the processing dialog.
Confirm initial focus is on Cancel.
Press Escape.
Inspect focus, lock and ledger state.
cases.expected: Dialog closes, focus returns to its trigger, the period stays open and no payment is created.

cases.title: Keep receipts stable across reload, copy and download
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: single.
cases.data: One successful NGN150,000 payment; clipboard permissions granted for the local test.
steps: Process payroll and open its receipt.
Reload the receipt page.
Copy the reference and read the clipboard.
Download the receipt and inspect its contents.
cases.expected: Receipt reference remains visible and unchanged. Clipboard contains that reference; downloaded receipt names Amara Okafor.

cases.title: Export only the employee records shown by the filter
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: standard.
cases.data: Processed standard payroll; Employee filter Daniel Mensah.
steps: Open Payments and filter to Daniel.
Confirm one visible record.
Export the filtered payments and inspect the CSV.
cases.expected: One record is shown. Export contains Daniel and 200000.00, and excludes Amara.

cases.title: Show the selected period without mixing payroll totals
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: standard.
cases.data: 13 October period paid NGN435,000; one pending next-period earning.
steps: Open Overview after processing the first period.
Select pay date 20 October.
Inspect period label, recorded pay and pending approvals.
cases.expected: Next-period label is 12–18 October 2026, recorded pay is NGN0.00, and one approval is pending.

cases.title: Keep seven payroll routes usable at 320 pixels
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: standard.
cases.data: Standard period processed with one notification failure; viewport 320 x 800.
steps: Set viewport to 320 x 800.
Open Overview, Employees, employee details, Earnings, Pay runs, Payments and Notifications.
Inspect page width and Pay runs navigation on each.
cases.expected: No route has horizontal page overflow; Pay runs navigation remains in the viewport.

cases.title: Support skip navigation and payroll dialog keyboard control
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: single.
cases.data: Overview loaded; keyboard navigation only for the tested sequence.
steps: Tab to Skip to content and activate it.
Focus and activate Review pay run.
Open payroll confirmation with Enter.
Tab through dialog controls, then press Escape.
cases.expected: Skip link focuses main; route change focuses the page title; Cancel is first, Process payroll follows, and Escape restores trigger focus.

cases.title: Carry the selected employee into earning entry
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: single.
cases.data: Employee Daniel Mensah; masked account ending 3068.
steps: Open Employees and choose Daniel.
Inspect his name and masked destination.
Select Record earnings.
cases.expected: Daniel details and destination are correct; the earning form preselects emp-002.

cases.title: Show payroll totals and professional product language
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: standard.
cases.data: Three employees; approved payroll NGN435,000.
steps: Open Overview.
Inspect its title, payroll total and rendered text.
Open Employees and capture the directory.
cases.expected: Overview shows Payroll overview and NGN435,000. No old banking, WebMCP or assessment labels appear in its rendered body.

cases.title: Recover a pending message while retaining the original receipt
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: single.
cases.data: One successful payment with notification failure.
steps: Open Notifications and inspect the delivery error.
Select Retry pending notifications.
Compare full payment objects and pending count.
Inspect the recovery button after completion.
cases.expected: The payment is unchanged, pending count is zero and the completed recovery action is disabled.

cases.title: Retain each tab workspace and chosen pay date
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: single A; standard B.
cases.data: A selects 20 October; B remains on 13 October.
steps: Open A, change its date, and navigate away and back.
Open B in a second tab.
Reload both tabs and inspect their period selectors and totals.
Switch A back to 13 October and compare A with B.
cases.expected: A keeps its own date and workspace. A shows NGN150,000 for its original period; B independently retains NGN435,000 and 13 October.

cases.title: Prove the running app is the selected build and cannot switch policy
cases.preconditions: An isolated workspace in the selected build. Pay date 2026-10-13 09:00 UTC; period [2026-10-05 00:00 UTC, 2026-10-12 00:00 UTC). Employee emp-001 is Amara Okafor. Starting fixture: build metadata.
cases.data: Expected build ID/source fingerprint from pair.json; opposite implementation requested via workspace creation.
steps: Read /api/health and compare build identity with pair.json.
Try to create a workspace specifying the opposite behavior.
Inspect the rejection status.
cases.expected: Served build ID and source fingerprint match the selected folder; policy-switch request returns HTTP 400.
